ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is an east-west terrain profile near 40°N, with longitudes such as about 100°E, 110°E, and 120°E marked horizontally, and “ocean” marked on the right side. Terrain unit Ding is located on the right side of the profile, in the area east of the Taihang Mountains; the terrain appears low and flat, and its eastern side is close to the ocean. Then reason: the low and flat terrain unit east of the Taihang Mountains and close to the ocean corresponds to the North China Plain. According to knowledge of Chinese regional geography, the southern boundary of the North China Plain is the Huai River. Therefore, the southern boundary of Ding is the Huai River.
